aboutH2: Fresh Start Recovery Centre: Men's Addiction Treatment in Calgary, Alberta
intro: The Fresh Start Recovery Centre is an all men drug and alcohol treatment centre. They provide a safe and secure environment in which the addicts can receive the help and support they need once withdrawal is behind them. The primary program lasts 90 days. We offer residential treatment and Out-patient which includes counselling, on a one-on-one basis and a group basis. In order for the addicts to participate in the long-term rehab program, they have to show abstinence.

In addition to the 50-bed primary treatment centre, Fresh Start now runs recovery-oriented housing with 114 beds across Calgary and Lethbridge for people needing affordable, supported housing to successfully continue their journey of long term recovery and integrate back into community. Everyday Fresh Start works with people to give them the tools they need to break free from addiction. As our participants go through their lifelong journey of active recovery, each one regains trust and independence and in doing so rebuilds relationships with family, employers and friends and returns to community as an active, engaged, contributing member of society.

pillars.title: How We Do It: A 12 Step, Abstinence Based Program
pillars.body: Fresh Start is an abstinence based men’s alcohol and drug addiction treatment centre grounded on a proven 12 step model of recovery with a formal program that runs for 90 days. Fresh Start recognizes, respects and works with each individual and their unique set of circumstances to create and manage a recovery plan that increases their odds of succeeding. Personal responsibility, accountability and honesty are the cornerstones of the program and people tend to live up to our expectations of them and – more importantly – their expectations of themselves.

pillars.title: A 50-Bed Facility for Men in Northeast Calgary
pillars.body: Fresh Start opened its Calgary facility at 411 41 Avenue NE in 2012, and it holds 50 treatment beds for men. Rooms are single or double, and the building has its own group rooms, a meditation and gathering space, a dining room, a gymnasium, a fitness centre, a games room and a small movie theatre. Laundry is on site, the building is wheelchair accessible with an elevator to every floor, and major transit routes run close by. Fresh Start also runs two facilities near Lethbridge, including a co-ed program, so couples and family members can be placed at different sites.

pillars.title: Outreach, Housing and an Alumni Community
pillars.body: Before treatment ends, your counsellor and an Outreach Peer Support Worker build a plan for what comes next. Outreach offers weekly check-ins, help with resumes and job searches, life skills coaching and relapse prevention, and staff can be reached around the clock. Some graduates move into Fresh Start's recovery-oriented housing, which had 114 abstinent beds across Calgary and Lethbridge at the end of 2025. Weekly alumni meetings keep people in touch, and Outreach supported 427 people that year.

overviewH2: Fresh Start Recovery Centre: Centre Overview
overview: At Fresh Start we recognize addictions as a chronic disease and our program is designed to eliminate the bad habits associated with drinking and drug use and model good habits consistent with healthy lifestyles. This view of addiction is gaining acceptance in mainstream Canadian medicine, after many years of being viewed by many as a moral deficiency.

serviceCaption: 12 services · as described on the centre's website
afterOverview: Throughout the program, participants are equipped with additional life skills and tools that help them to model and continue to lead a healthy lifestyle once they have completed their program. These skills include a better understanding of the importance of nutrition, exercise, meditation, career search skills, cultural sensitivity and a number of other practical skills in their recovery process. The duration of the program is as important as the program’s content as it has proven to provide participants sufficient time to model and adopt new behaviours while decreasing the danger of them reverting to their old, familiar, destructive behaviours. Our program is longer than many other treatment programs that are characteristically prone to the “Spin Dry” effect – living drug and/or alcohol free for a shorter time period with increased risk of relapse shortly after the program ends. With limited space in our residential program and a wait list running 30 to 90 days, we offer a day Program for people who have safe, affordable housing to return to each night.

Our track record: Fresh Start recorded an 80% treatment completion rate across its three facilities in 2025, and 81% at the Calgary facility. The staff at Fresh Start collectively has more than 250 years of firsthand active recovery experience. We know addictions, we know what’s involved in successful recovery, we take our job of helping others recover every day very seriously and we are effective, efficient and successful!

location.heading: Fresh Start Recovery Centre in Calgary, Alberta
location.intro: Fresh Start's Calgary facility sits on 41 Avenue NE, just east of Centre Street in Calgary's north end, with major transit routes nearby. Downtown Calgary is about 15 minutes away by car, Airdrie about 25 minutes up Deerfoot Trail, Red Deer about an hour and a half, and Lethbridge, where Fresh Start runs its two other facilities, about two and a quarter hours south.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Fresh Start Recovery Centre cost?
faqs.a: For Albertans with valid Alberta Health Care, treatment is currently covered, according to the centre's FAQ. People without Alberta Health Care, including anyone from another province, pay a fee that the centre does not publish, and its Director of Finance goes over cost and funding options. Staff also help clients apply for income support such as Alberta Works once they arrive.

The primary residential program runs 90 days, and clients are expected to stay for all of it. The centre suggests packing for 14 to 16 weeks, and admissions can confirm the program options at each facility.

faqs.q: Is the Calgary facility for men only?
faqs.a: Yes. The Calgary facility on 41 Avenue NE is a 50-bed program for adult men, as Charity Intelligence and the Northwest Territories health department both describe it. Women can attend Fresh Start's co-ed facility near Lethbridge, about two and a quarter hours south.

No. There is no detox on site, and you need at least 5 days of sobriety before you come in. The centre recommends going through a detox program first, because withdrawal can be dangerous and is best handled by trained medical staff.

faqs.q: Where is Fresh Start Recovery Centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The Calgary facility is at 411 41 Ave NE, just east of Centre Street in Calgary's north end. It is about 15 minutes by car from downtown Calgary and close to major transit routes. The building is wheelchair accessible, with an elevator to every floor.

Start by calling admissions at 403-387-6266 or toll free at 1-844-768-6266. The team uses a triaged waitlist, and you are asked to check in by phone every day while you wait, since repeated missed check-ins can take you off the list. When a bed opens, they confirm your arrival date, the facility and what to bring.

You keep working with Fresh Start's Outreach team, which offers weekly check-ins, job search help, life skills coaching and relapse prevention, with staff on call 24/7. Some graduates move into the centre's recovery-oriented housing, which had 114 beds across Calgary and Lethbridge at the end of 2025. Weekly alumni meetings are open to everyone who finishes treatment.
Yes. People who have a safe, supportive home can join the at-cost Day Program, which covers the same treatment content as the live-in program. Day participants go home after dinner each evening.

faqs.q: Can family visit, and is there help for families?
faqs.a: Yes. Family and friends can visit Monday to Sunday between 10:00 am and 10:00 pm, outside program hours. The Family and Friends Healing Initiative runs eight two-hour evening sessions over four weeks, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with a sliding scale fee.

faqs.q: Can I work or go to school during treatment?
faqs.a: No. During the 90-day program you cannot work or attend school, so you can focus on group work and reflection. Your counsellor helps you plan for employment, education and housing as treatment goes on.

faqs.q: Is Fresh Start licensed and accredited?
faqs.a: Yes. Fresh Start holds a Government of Alberta licence for residential addiction treatment under the Mental Health Services Protection Act (MHSPA 10000377), which covers the Calgary facility and runs to November 30, 2026. In 2025 it also achieved Exemplary Standing with Accreditation Canada across all three facilities.
